scope: Synthetic public Stroke generic SVG and direct PDF exports versus retained native Montblanc RTV1 host-Mesa frames. Not native PDF, full note loading, or Android device parity.

inputs.points: (128,128), (138,128), (148,126); far endpoint (158,126), corresponding to captured positions with x=128+x and y=128-y

native_provenance: See conformance/montblanc-triangle-export-comparison.json and tools/montblanc/captures/*.json.gz. Synthetic real Drawing/ObjectStroke/RTV1 producer and native Draw; controlled buffer sequencing, host EGL/GLES adapters, Mesa llvmpipe. Native RGBA readback rows flipped and composited onto #fcfcfc.
method: Rasterize SVG with resvg; PDF with MuPDF fitted to 256x256 RGB. Support is any RGB channel more than 2 from 252. Values are native support, export support, intersection, union, RGB byte L1 summed on union. PDF background can differ slightly from #fcfcfc and contributes to L1. Native framebuffer RGB is premultiplied and is composited over paper with nearest-integer source-over.
reproduction: From repository root run .venv/bin/python tools/montblanc/public_fallback_compare.py. Requires pinned ignored source fixture, offline Cargo dependencies, resvg, Pillow and PyMuPDF. Generated SVG/PDF/PNG stay in a temporary directory.
